verdict.rationale: EDD's e-Services portal collects employer and payroll data, so an AI-training opt-out or data-use policy is a fair privacy-posture question for this kind of service. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use restrictions, or any opt-out control. The pack covers only payroll tax account functions, payments, enrollment verification, and probe results.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
